about: Names, descriptions and grades are the official PlayStation list, as published. Every guide below is written for this tracker in its own words and names the published guides it draws on. Kind, hidden and missable flags are editorial: kind groups trophies for filtering, hidden follows the launch-week lists, and exactly one trophy is flagged missable.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum awards itself the moment the other 54 trophies are earned, so there is nothing separate to hunt for it. Plan the whole run around the two golds instead — the finished story and the 100% Completion checklist — and let this be the last trophy that ever ticks over.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap, https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap, https://www.pushsquare.com/guides/gta-6-trophy-guide-and-roadmap

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Finish Gone Fishing, the opening mission of Chapter 1. It is a story trophy on a linear campaign path, so it unlocks on its own as the mission ends and there is no way to walk past it.
sources: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap, https://www.pushsquare.com/guides/gta-6-trophy-guide-and-roadmap
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap, https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Play Chapter 1 through to its end and the trophy lands during the closing scenes. While you are still in this chapter, handle the game's one missable moment: after the mission Down to Earth, Lucia can be found at Jason's house in the morning and leads him out to meditate on the balcony. Do that before the chapter closes, because the game has no mission replay.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap, https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/
KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap, https://www.keengamer.com/articles/guides/gta-6-trophy-guide-platinum-roadmap-all-55-trophies/

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2 of the story. Chapter trophies are automatic and unmissable, so simply keep following the main mission markers. From this chapter on, both protagonists are playable, which is also what opens up the later meditation spots for Positive Mental Attitude.
sources: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap, https://www.pushsquare.com/guides/gta-6-trophy-guide-and-roadmap
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap, https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3. The trophy is awarded automatically as the chapter ends and nothing optional is tied to it, so a story-focused run picks it up on the way through.
sources: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap, https://www.pushsquare.com/guides/gta-6-trophy-guide-and-roadmap

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4. One practical reason not to rush it: the optional Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is... sets up the bank-vault route that Maximum Withdrawal depends on, so take optional missions as they surface instead of beelining for the chapter's end.
sources: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap, https://www.pushsquare.com/guides/gta-6-trophy-guide-and-roadmap
EGamers.io — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies and Achievements, https://egamers.io/gta-6-trophy-list-all-55-trophies-and-achievements-plus-the-hardest-ones/

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final story mission of Chapter 5 to earn the story's only gold trophy. After the credits you are returned to free-roam in Leonida with no mission replay, so everything still outstanding is cleaned up in the open world rather than by replaying the campaign.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap, https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap, https://www.pushsquare.com/guides/gta-6-trophy-guide-and-roadmap

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. It sits on the main campaign path, so it unlocks in sequence as you play and cannot be missed.
sources: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap, https://www.pushsquare.com/guides/gta-6-trophy-guide-and-roadmap
EGamers.io — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies and Achievements, https://egamers.io/gta-6-trophy-list-all-55-trophies-and-achievements-plus-the-hardest-ones/

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete The Cartel Heist, a set-piece heist mission on the main story path. The trophy unlocks as the heist wraps up; no optional objectives or performance targets are attached to it.
sources: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap, https://www.pushsquare.com/guides/gta-6-trophy-guide-and-roadmap
EGamers.io — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies and Achievements, https://egamers.io/gta-6-trophy-list-all-55-trophies-and-achievements-plus-the-hardest-ones/

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. It is a main-path mission, earned in order as the campaign unfolds, with nothing extra to prepare.
sources: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap, https://www.pushsquare.com/guides/gta-6-trophy-guide-and-roadmap
EGamers.io — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies and Achievements, https://egamers.io/gta-6-trophy-list-all-55-trophies-and-achievements-plus-the-hardest-ones/

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. Part of the linear campaign, so any playthrough that finishes the story earns it along the way.
sources: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap, https://www.pushsquare.com/guides/gta-6-trophy-guide-and-roadmap
EGamers.io — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies and Achievements, https://egamers.io/gta-6-trophy-list-all-55-trophies-and-achievements-plus-the-hardest-ones/

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete VCIA Takedown, the story mission built around Vice City International Airport. It lies on the main mission path and the trophy unlocks as the mission ends.
sources: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap, https://www.pushsquare.com/guides/gta-6-trophy-guide-and-roadmap
EGamers.io — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies and Achievements, https://egamers.io/gta-6-trophy-list-all-55-trophies-and-achievements-plus-the-hardest-ones/

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete Operation Savage Glory, a late story mission on the main path. Like the other named-mission trophies it is automatic and unmissable.
sources: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap, https://www.pushsquare.com/guides/gta-6-trophy-guide-and-roadmap
EGamers.io — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies and Achievements, https://egamers.io/gta-6-trophy-list-all-55-trophies-and-achievements-plus-the-hardest-ones/

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Fill the 100% Completion checklist, which only becomes visible after the story (Touch Pad, then Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion). The thresholds are forgiving — roughly 60% of everything the game holds — and most of the list fills in while you chase other trophies: robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests are required in full, but challenges only need 70 of 80, vehicle scans 200 of 277 and animal studies 100 of 255. It is rated the hardest trophy in the game and takes around 100 hours as a step of its own.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap, https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/
KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap, https://www.keengamer.com/articles/guides/gta-6-trophy-guide-platinum-roadmap-all-55-trophies/
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap, https://www.pushsquare.com/guides/gta-6-trophy-guide-and-roadmap

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunt jumps. Leonida holds 397 stunts, so you need roughly two-thirds of them, and the 100% checklist separately asks for 300 — every stunt past this trophy still pays off. Flying under bridges is rated the quickest stunt type to farm; otherwise, work stunt icons into your travel routes instead of saving them all for the cleanup.
sources: EGamers.io — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies and Achievements, https://egamers.io/gta-6-trophy-list-all-55-trophies-and-achievements-plus-the-hardest-ones/
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap, https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Sample each of the game's 9 activity types once — races, shooting ranges, fishing, arcade games and the rest of the activity icons on the map. A single attempt at each is enough; you do not need to win or take a medal, so sweep one round of everything early and this trophy is finished.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap, https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/
EGamers.io — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies and Achievements, https://egamers.io/gta-6-trophy-list-all-55-trophies-and-achievements-plus-the-hardest-ones/

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. The ranges are also a full requirement of the 100% checklist, so there is no way around them; learn each weapon's challenge layout, and if a gold is out of reach on a first visit, come back later with better weapons and more practice.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap, https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/
KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap, https://www.keengamer.com/articles/guides/gta-6-trophy-guide-platinum-roadmap-all-55-trophies/

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every location: 14 locations holding 42 races in all, and it is a win at each location that the trophy counts. Drone races are also required in full by the 100% checklist, so every win here pays off twice.
sources: EGamers.io — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies and Achievements, https://egamers.io/gta-6-trophy-list-all-55-trophies-and-achievements-plus-the-hardest-ones/
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap, https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — repeats of the same race do not add to the count, so keep moving on to fresh race markers. The 100% checklist asks for 30 unique race wins, which means this trophy lands on the way if you race as you explore.
sources: EGamers.io — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies and Achievements, https://egamers.io/gta-6-trophy-list-all-55-trophies-and-achievements-plus-the-hardest-ones/
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap, https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in his fishing challenge: take on the challenge, land the better catch under its rules, and the trophy pops when you come out ahead. Fishing is one of the activity types, so the attempt also ticks a box for Master of None.
sources: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap, https://www.pushsquare.com/guides/gta-6-trophy-guide-and-roadmap
EGamers.io — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies and Achievements, https://egamers.io/gta-6-trophy-list-all-55-trophies-and-achievements-plus-the-hardest-ones/

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete any one arcade game from start to finish. Pick the shortest cabinet you can find among Leonida's arcades and bars; a single completed game is all this trophy asks for.
sources: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap, https://www.pushsquare.com/guides/gta-6-trophy-guide-and-roadmap
EGamers.io — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies and Achievements, https://egamers.io/gta-6-trophy-list-all-55-trophies-and-achievements-plus-the-hardest-ones/

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Close out Andy's stranger strand by completing his final mission. Andy's quests are Lucia-only, and his chain is one of the strands that count toward the silver Strangers & Freaks trophy — start his missions when they appear rather than leaving the whole chain for the endgame.
sources: EGamers.io — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies and Achievements, https://egamers.io/gta-6-trophy-list-all-55-trophies-and-achievements-plus-the-hardest-ones/
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap, https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Kenton's stranger strand. Work his missions as they unlock; finishing his last job also advances the eight-strand total that Strangers & Freaks counts.
sources: EGamers.io — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies and Achievements, https://egamers.io/gta-6-trophy-list-all-55-trophies-and-achievements-plus-the-hardest-ones/
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap, https://www.pushsquare.com/guides/gta-6-trophy-guide-and-roadmap

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete Billy's final stranger mission. His strand is one of the eight that the silver Strangers & Freaks trophy counts, so finishing it is never wasted effort.
sources: EGamers.io — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies and Achievements, https://egamers.io/gta-6-trophy-list-all-55-trophies-and-achievements-plus-the-hardest-ones/
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap, https://www.pushsquare.com/guides/gta-6-trophy-guide-and-roadmap

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 full mission strands for strangers across Leonida. The strands with named trophy finales — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone, plus Bret's hunting work — cover most of the eight. Once the story is over, every quest giver tied to a trophy returns to the map, so any strand you left behind can still be mopped up in free-roam.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap, https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/
KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap, https://www.keengamer.com/articles/guides/gta-6-trophy-guide-platinum-roadmap-all-55-trophies/

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete Randy's final stranger mission to close his strand — one of the eight strands counted by Strangers & Freaks.
sources: EGamers.io — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies and Achievements, https://egamers.io/gta-6-trophy-list-all-55-trophies-and-achievements-plus-the-hardest-ones/
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap, https://www.pushsquare.com/guides/gta-6-trophy-guide-and-roadmap

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. His strand is Jason-only, so switch to Jason when his missions are showing on the map, and finish the chain for another of the eight Strangers & Freaks strands.
sources: EGamers.io — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies and Achievements, https://egamers.io/gta-6-trophy-list-all-55-trophies-and-achievements-plus-the-hardest-ones/
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap, https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: MISSABLE — the one trophy in the game that can be lost. Meditate at every spot across Leonida: 18 spots by GTABase's count, while the 100% checklist only asks for 15. The danger is the first spot: Lucia's balcony meditation at Jason's house in Chapter 1, available after the mission Down to Earth when she is at the house in the morning. It disappears when Chapter 1 ends, and guides disagree on whether it is strictly required — do it to be safe, because there is no mission replay. The last spots only open once you can play as both characters, from Chapter 2 onward.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap, https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/
KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap, https://www.keengamer.com/articles/guides/gta-6-trophy-guide-platinum-roadmap-all-55-trophies/
EGamers.io — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies and Achievements, https://egamers.io/gta-6-trophy-list-all-55-trophies-and-achievements-plus-the-hardest-ones/

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Take on Bret's hunting work and bring down the unique animal he sends you after. Bret's quests are Jason-only and are required in full for the 100% checklist. Which animal counts as the unique one was still unconfirmed in launch-week guides, so follow Bret's quest markers rather than hunting at random.
sources: EGamers.io — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies and Achievements, https://egamers.io/gta-6-trophy-list-all-55-trophies-and-achievements-plus-the-hardest-ones/
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap, https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete any 3 full Collectible Card sets. There are 18 sets in the game and the 100% checklist wants 15 of them completed, so card hunting is worth doing properly in the long run — but for this trophy itself, concentrate your searching on three sets and finish those first.
sources: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap, https://www.pushsquare.com/guides/gta-6-trophy-guide-and-roadmap
KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap, https://www.keengamer.com/articles/guides/gta-6-trophy-guide-platinum-roadmap-all-55-trophies/

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use WAiNK at 100 locations. The 100% checklist asks for exactly the same 100, so every location counts twice over; make WAiNK stops part of your travel routine whenever you pass a new spot instead of saving them all for one long sweep at the end.
sources: EGamers.io — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies and Achievements, https://egamers.io/gta-6-trophy-list-all-55-trophies-and-achievements-plus-the-hardest-ones/
KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap, https://www.keengamer.com/articles/guides/gta-6-trophy-guide-platinum-roadmap-all-55-trophies/

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the game's Challenges. There are 80 challenges in eight groups of ten, and the 100% checklist needs 70 of them — so do not stop at this trophy's 50; push on toward 70 and let the checklist requirement carry you.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap, https://www.keengamer.com/articles/guides/gta-6-trophy-guide-platinum-roadmap-all-55-trophies/
EGamers.io — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies and Achievements, https://egamers.io/gta-6-trophy-list-all-55-trophies-and-achievements-plus-the-hardest-ones/

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner alongside you, build a 4-star wanted level and then lose it completely and escape the heat. Bank vault robberies are a reliable way to draw the stars; guides point to the train tunnel north of Ambrosia as a dependable place to break line of sight and let the level drain away.
sources: EGamers.io — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies and Achievements, https://egamers.io/gta-6-trophy-list-all-55-trophies-and-achievements-plus-the-hardest-ones/

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner while the wanted level stays alive between them — if you go clean between shops, the chain breaks. The jewelry stores of North Vice City sit close together, which keeps the travel between hits short; if the trophy has not popped after the third shop, rob a fourth.
sources: EGamers.io — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies and Achievements, https://egamers.io/gta-6-trophy-list-all-55-trophies-and-achievements-plus-the-hardest-ones/

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles by scanning them with WAiNK — you do not need to drive them. Busy roads are the efficient hunting ground: park where traffic is dense and scan everything that passes. The 100% checklist wants 200 of the game's 277 base models scanned, so keep going after this trophy pops.
sources: EGamers.io — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies and Achievements, https://egamers.io/gta-6-trophy-list-all-55-trophies-and-achievements-plus-the-hardest-ones/
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap, https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies inside a single use of Combat Focus. Fill the Focus meter before you start, bring an assault rifle, and pick the fight with gang members — reports say cops, soldiers and civilians do not count toward the five.
sources: EGamers.io — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies and Achievements, https://egamers.io/gta-6-trophy-list-all-55-trophies-and-achievements-plus-the-hardest-ones/

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure from VCIA, the airport. GTABase's method: steal a docked passenger jet on the airport grounds and fly it roughly a kilometre away from the field.
sources: EGamers.io — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies and Achievements, https://egamers.io/gta-6-trophy-list-all-55-trophies-and-achievements-plus-the-hardest-ones/

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: The Rhinos are military tanks. GTABase's route: steal one from Mile Zero Air Station and take out enemies from inside it — once you are rolling, the armour makes the kills the easy part.
sources: EGamers.io — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies and Achievements, https://egamers.io/gta-6-trophy-list-all-55-trophies-and-achievements-plus-the-hardest-ones/

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected at any point. Enter through the back door with the Snap Gun, find the safe code, and empty the safe quietly — being spotted even once voids the attempt, so leave the loud approach at home.
sources: EGamers.io — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies and Achievements, https://egamers.io/gta-6-trophy-list-all-55-trophies-and-achievements-plus-the-hardest-ones/

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape after each one; the 100% checklist later asks for 8 vault robberies, so this trophy is a waypoint rather than the finish. The reliable setup comes from the optional Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is...: follow a security van into a bank while its vault stands open. Expect a 4-star escape, and stage a fast bike outside before you go in.
sources: EGamers.io — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies and Achievements, https://egamers.io/gta-6-trophy-list-all-55-trophies-and-achievements-plus-the-hardest-ones/
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap, https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and get away with it: stop the truck, crack it open, take the cash and break line of sight until the heat drops. One successful truck is all the trophy needs.
sources: EGamers.io — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies and Achievements, https://egamers.io/gta-6-trophy-list-all-55-trophies-and-achievements-plus-the-hardest-ones/
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap, https://www.pushsquare.com/guides/gta-6-trophy-guide-and-roadmap

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — clear the fog from the whole map across its 52 areas. Flying over the still-dark patches is the fastest way to reveal what remains, so leave this until you have aircraft access and mop up the last pockets of fog in a single flight pass.
sources: EGamers.io — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies and Achievements, https://egamers.io/gta-6-trophy-list-all-55-trophies-and-achievements-plus-the-hardest-ones/
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap, https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs — one operation per gang is enough for the trophy. Gang operations are a far bigger part of the 100% checklist (39 of them), so note which gang each operation belongs to as you go and aim at the gangs you are still missing.
sources: EGamers.io — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies and Achievements, https://egamers.io/gta-6-trophy-list-all-55-trophies-and-achievements-plus-the-hardest-ones/
KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap, https://www.keengamer.com/articles/guides/gta-6-trophy-guide-platinum-roadmap-all-55-trophies/

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. The exact trigger was still unconfirmed in launch-week guides — PowerPyx lists the steps as not yet known — so when you are on Ocean Beach, work through its bars and take the cocktail prompt with the ocean in view.
sources: EGamers.io — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies and Achievements, https://egamers.io/gta-6-trophy-list-all-55-trophies-and-achievements-plus-the-hardest-ones/

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom through its glass, in classic style. GTABase's unconfirmed reading is that you drive a car straight out through the showroom window; the steps were not confirmed at launch, so find a showroom with a car inside and take the dramatic exit.
sources: EGamers.io — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies and Achievements, https://egamers.io/gta-6-trophy-list-all-55-trophies-and-achievements-plus-the-hardest-ones/

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Play the follow-through at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley — visit the alley and complete its bowling activity there. The official wording is cryptic, and launch-week guides had pinned down the location rather than any extra trick.
sources: EGamers.io — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies and Achievements, https://egamers.io/gta-6-trophy-list-all-55-trophies-and-achievements-plus-the-hardest-ones/
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap, https://www.pushsquare.com/guides/gta-6-trophy-guide-and-roadmap

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: GTABase links this one to your characters' bodies: max out the Strength stat for both Jason and Lucia. Build strength through melee fights, sports and other physical activities for both protagonists, not just your favourite of the two.
sources: EGamers.io — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies and Achievements, https://egamers.io/gta-6-trophy-list-all-55-trophies-and-achievements-plus-the-hardest-ones/

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Make 500 choices that change your Criminal Profile — PlayStation tracks the running count for this one, and GTABase ties the qualifying actions to the profile system. Active play stacks them up across a full run; just remember the Irredeemable profile state is permanent, so check what an action does to your profile before going on a rampage.
sources: EGamers.io — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies and Achievements, https://egamers.io/gta-6-trophy-list-all-55-trophies-and-achievements-plus-the-hardest-ones/
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap, https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. The steps were unconfirmed at launch — PowerPyx lists this trophy as not yet known — and the description points at failing at something once and succeeding on the retry. Practical advice: do not reload a save after a small failure; let the failed attempt stand and succeed on the second try.
sources: EGamers.io — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies and Achievements, https://egamers.io/gta-6-trophy-list-all-55-trophies-and-achievements-plus-the-hardest-ones/
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap, https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Witness something strange out in Leonida. Unconfirmed at launch: GTABase's best guess is a scripted strange event somewhere in the state. Explore off the main routes — the swamps and the Keys after dark are the classic hunting grounds for this series' weird moments — and investigate anything that looks out of place.
sources: EGamers.io — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies and Achievements, https://egamers.io/gta-6-trophy-list-all-55-trophies-and-achievements-plus-the-hardest-ones/
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap, https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl someone over with a melee drive-by: swing a melee weapon from a moving vehicle and knock a pedestrian or enemy down with it. The steps were unconfirmed at launch beyond the description itself; a motorcycle at moderate speed along a busy pavement gives you the most chances per pass.
sources: EGamers.io — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies and Achievements, https://egamers.io/gta-6-trophy-list-all-55-trophies-and-achievements-plus-the-hardest-ones/
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap, https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked bills pile up from the robbery work the 100% checklist demands anyway; move them through fences rather than spending them, and note that guides say one fence pays noticeably better than the others.
sources: EGamers.io — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies and Achievements, https://egamers.io/gta-6-trophy-list-all-55-trophies-and-achievements-plus-the-hardest-ones/
KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap, https://www.keengamer.com/articles/guides/gta-6-trophy-guide-platinum-roadmap-all-55-trophies/

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Ordinary play covers much of it — vehicles, weapons, clothes and services all count — and the garage-buying spree for Little Boxes will carry you a good part of the way on its own.
sources: EGamers.io — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies and Achievements, https://egamers.io/gta-6-trophy-list-all-55-trophies-and-achievements-plus-the-hardest-ones/
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap, https://www.pushsquare.com/guides/gta-6-trophy-guide-and-roadmap

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties in the Vice City Real Estate app, roughly $160,000 in total. The 4 garages the story hands you do not count toward the eight, so budget for the app's listings specifically.
sources: EGamers.io — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies and Achievements, https://egamers.io/gta-6-trophy-list-all-55-trophies-and-achievements-plus-the-hardest-ones/

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Whenever you take a new vehicle you plan to keep, register it on the spot; ten registrations accumulate quickly if you do it as you acquire cars rather than in one dedicated session.
